info.title: CaseSync - Police FIR & Criminal Investigation Management API
info.description: Production-grade RESTful API for CaseSync, a state-of-the-art Police FIR, Investigation, Evidence, and Chain-of-Custody Management System. Built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL with tamper-evident SHA-256 hash chaining, optimistic concurrency control, and role-based access control.
